title: Gov. Andrew Cuomo: ‘It’s Making Sure We Live Through This.’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I am now disinfecting this microphone for the governor and the windscreen,
sentences.zh: 我现在正在为州长和防风罩消毒这个麦克风，

sentences.en: because that's how we roll these days.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是我们现在的行事方式。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I travel everywhere now with Lysol wipes.
sentences.zh: 我现在去哪儿都带着来苏尔消毒湿巾。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, do you want to disinfect this?
sentences.zh: 嗯，对了，你想给这个消消毒吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Since you'll, maybe, depending on our sitting arrangement, might be holding that.
sentences.zh: 因为根据我们的座位安排，你可能需要拿着它。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, let's go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Where's the middle of the one?
sentences.zh: 中间那个在哪儿？

sentences.en: Oh, we're going to hold you.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们要拿着它。

sentences.en: Here are you.
sentences.zh: 给你。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hey, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Hey, Liz.
sentences.zh: 嘿，莉兹。

sentences.en: Are we allowed to shake hands?
sentences.zh: 我们能握手吗？

sentences.en: Oh, you're right, you're right, you're right.
sentences.zh: 哦，你说得对，你说得对，你说得对。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不行。

sentences.en: Ritual is very hard.
sentences.zh: 这种仪式感很难改。

sentences.en: Governor, this is Lindsay Garrison, Lisa Tobin, Governor Cuomo.
sentences.zh: 州长，这位是琳赛·加里森、丽莎·托宾，这是科莫州长。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: New York State has begun to aggressively move to control its spread.
sentences.zh: 纽约州已开始积极采取行动以控制病毒传播。

sentences.en: Governor Cuomo signing an executive order closing all schools statewide for the next two weeks.
sentences.zh: 科莫州长签署了一项行政命令，关闭全州所有学校，为期两周。

sentences.en: Now, this means all...
sentences.zh: 这意味着所有……

sentences.en: Taking a series of increasingly drastic steps over the past few days.
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里采取了一系列日益严厉的措施。

sentences.en: In New York, Governor Cuomo is advising non-essential businesses to close each night at 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，科莫州长建议非必要企业每晚8点关闭。

sentences.en: Mayor de Blasio warned New York City residents to be prepared for a possible shelter-in-place order in the next 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 白思豪市长警告纽约市民，要为未来48小时内可能发布的居家令做好准备。

sentences.en: Governor Cuomo shifts his emphasis to the health care system.
sentences.zh: 科莫州长将重心转移到了医疗保健系统上。

sentences.en: Today, a conversation with Governor Andrew Cuomo.
sentences.zh: 今天，与安德鲁·科莫州长的对话。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, March 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月18日，星期三。

sentences.en: So, I want to thank you for letting us...
sentences.zh: 所以，我要感谢你让我们……

sentences.en: I'm just examining...
sentences.zh: 我只是在检查……

sentences.en: Examining the microphone.
sentences.zh: 检查麦克风。

sentences.en: That's a windscreen.
sentences.zh: 那是防风罩。

sentences.en: It'll keep your...
sentences.zh: 它能让你的……

sentences.en: Keep the wind down.
sentences.zh: 挡住风。

sentences.en: The wind down.
sentences.zh: 挡住风。

sentences.en: It's just windy.
sentences.zh: 风太大了。

sentences.en: So, Governor, I want to thank you for letting us in in the middle of an extraordinary crisis and tell you how much we appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 那么，州长，我要感谢你在如此非凡的危机时刻让我们进来，并告诉你我们有多么感激。

sentences.en: I want to start this conversation by asking you where New York is in this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我想从询问纽约目前处于这场大流行的哪个阶段开始这次对话。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday afternoon around 3 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 现在是周二下午3点左右。

sentences.en: How many New Yorkers do we understand have the coronavirus at this point?
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，目前有多少纽约人感染了冠状病毒？

sentences.en: We have, right now, over 1,000 cases.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有超过1000例病例。

sentences.en: It's a little misleading because we're talking about these tests as if it's taking a random sample, right?
sentences.zh: 这有点误导人，因为我们谈论这些检测时，好像是在进行随机抽样，对吧？

sentences.en: But it's not.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: The test results are purely symbolic of how many tests you're taking.
sentences.zh: 检测结果纯粹象征着你进行了多少次检测。

sentences.en: We are now taking more tests than most states, and we're finding more positives, which would make sense also because we are the dense state.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的检测量比大多数州都多，所以我们发现的阳性病例也更多，这也是合理的，因为我们是人口最稠密的州。

sentences.en: And this is a function of density at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这是人口密度带来的结果。

sentences.en: You're getting on a subway train.
sentences.zh: 你要坐地铁。

sentences.en: You're getting on a bus.
sentences.zh: 你要坐公交车。

sentences.en: You're in a crowded restaurant.
sentences.zh: 你在拥挤的餐馆里。

sentences.en: You're in a crowded office space.
sentences.zh: 你在拥挤的办公空间里。

sentences.en: And this transfers in the crowds.
sentences.zh: 病毒就在人群中传播。

sentences.en: So that it would be here first is not surprising.
sentences.zh: 所以它首先出现在这里并不奇怪。

sentences.en: That it would communicate most easily here is not surprising.
sentences.zh: 它在这里最容易传播也不奇怪。

sentences.en: And that we would have the sophisticated health system that would detect it here first is not surprising.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有先进的医疗系统能率先检测到它，这也不奇怪。

sentences.en: So if these are the front lines of this epidemic, and I've heard you describe this as a kind of war that we're in right now,
sentences.zh: 如果这是这场流行病的前线，而且我听你形容这就像我们现在所处的一场战争，

sentences.en: what stage of the war are we at in a place like New York?
sentences.zh: 那么在纽约这样的地方，我们处于战争的哪个阶段？

sentences.en: We are seeing the enemy on the horizon, and they are approaching very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了地平线上的敌人，它们正在迅速逼近。

sentences.en: And we don't have our defenses in place.
sentences.zh: 而我们的防御工事还没有到位。

sentences.en: We don't.
sentences.zh: 确实没有。

sentences.en: We don't.
sentences.zh: 确实没有。

sentences.en: Testing was the first level of defense, right?
sentences.zh: 检测是第一道防线，对吧？

sentences.en: The testing was slow nationwide.
sentences.zh: 全国范围内的检测都很缓慢。

sentences.en: We're now ramping up in this state because the federal government, I think, made a wise decision.
sentences.zh: 我们州现在正在加大力度，因为我认为联邦政府做出了一个明智的决定。

sentences.en: We were the first to ask for it.
sentences.zh: 我们是第一个提出要求的。

sentences.en: I asked the president for it directly.
sentences.zh: 我直接向总统提出了要求。

sentences.en: Basically said, decentralize the testing, leave it to the states.
sentences.zh: 基本上是说，下放检测权，交给各州处理。

sentences.en: We have 200 laboratories in this state.
sentences.zh: 我们州有200个实验室。

sentences.en: I said, decentralize it.
sentences.zh: 我说，下放权力。

sentences.en: Let the states do it.
sentences.zh: 让各州自己做。

sentences.en: But you weren't allowed at first to do it.
sentences.zh: 但起初你们是不被允许这样做的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The federal government was controlling it, and you were running all the national tests through the CDC, which was then sending them to Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府控制着它，你们所有的全国性检测都通过疾控中心进行，然后送到亚特兰大。

sentences.en: So we're now ramping up on testing.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在正在加大检测力度。

sentences.en: That's why our numbers are high.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们的数字很高。

sentences.en: But testing is no longer going to keep the genie in the bottle, right?
sentences.zh: 但检测已经无法再把精灵关回瓶子里了，对吧？

sentences.en: The genie is out of the bottle now.
sentences.zh: 精灵现在已经跑出来了。

sentences.en: Where this all comes down to is when they talk about flattening the curve, flattening the curve.
sentences.zh: 这一切归根结底就是人们所说的“拉平曲线”，拉平曲线。

sentences.en: They're trying to slow the advance of the enemy until we can get enough of our defenses in place.
sentences.zh: 他们试图减缓敌人的推进速度，直到我们能建立足够的防御。

sentences.en: What are the defenses?
sentences.zh: 什么是防御？

sentences.en: A health care system that can handle the injured, to torture the metaphor.
sentences.zh: 一个能够处理伤员的医疗系统，如果非要用这个比喻的话。

sentences.en: And we're not there.
sentences.zh: 而我们还没做到。

sentences.en: If you look at the speed, the increase in the rate, the spike in the increase of the number of cases, we're looking at a possibility of an apex being about 45 days away.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看病例增长的速度、比率和激增情况，我们可能会在45天后达到顶峰。

sentences.en: The peak of this pandemic here.
sentences.zh: 这场大流行在这里的顶峰。

sentences.en: The peak.
sentences.zh: 顶峰。

sentences.en: That's one projection.
sentences.zh: 这是一种预测。

sentences.en: 45 days.
Needing 110,000 hospital beds.
sentences.zh: 需要11万张病床。

sentences.en: In this state, you have 50,000 hospital beds.
sentences.zh: 在这个州，你有5万张病床。

sentences.en: Needing 37,000 intensive care unit beds.
sentences.zh: 需要3.7万张重症监护病床。

sentences.en: And having 3,000 ICU beds.
sentences.zh: 而我们只有3000张ICU病床。

sentences.en: Needing 37,000, having 3.
sentences.zh: 需要3.7万张，却只有3000张。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's a pretty extraordinary gap.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当巨大的缺口。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because the injured here are going to be predominantly senior citizens, compromised immune systems, underlying illness.
sentences.zh: 因为这里的伤员主要是老年人、免疫系统受损者和患有基础疾病的人。

sentences.en: And those people need ICUs.
sentences.zh: 这些人需要ICU。

sentences.en: When they come into the hospital, they don't need a normal bed and moderate health care.
sentences.zh: 当他们来到医院时，他们需要的不是普通病床和一般的医疗护理。

sentences.en: They need an ICU.
sentences.zh: 他们需要ICU。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about your leadership in this war, to similarly torture the metaphor, the work you've done in the last few days to flatten the curve.
sentences.zh: 所以我想谈谈你在这场战争中的领导力，同样借用这个比喻，谈谈你过去几天为拉平曲线所做的工作。

sentences.en: Because you've made some extraordinary decisions in the past 72 hours or so.
sentences.zh: 因为你在过去72小时左右做出了一些非凡的决定。

sentences.en: Efforts to essentially kind of start shutting down systematically elements of our life here in New York.
sentences.zh: 努力从本质上开始系统地关闭我们在纽约生活的各个方面。

sentences.en: So help me understand the information that you've been receiving, the calculations that you've been weighing,
sentences.zh: 所以请帮我理解你所收到的信息，你所权衡的计算，

sentences.en: and the very real trade-offs that you understood would have to be made.
sentences.zh: 以及你明白必须做出的非常现实的权衡。

sentences.en: I'm watching the increase in cases.
sentences.zh: 我一直在观察病例的增加。

sentences.en: And you take one measure and you see what the effect was.
sentences.zh: 你采取一项措施，看看效果如何。

sentences.en: You take another measure and you see what the effect was.
sentences.zh: 你再采取另一项措施，看看效果如何。

sentences.en: And nothing was having an effect.
sentences.zh: 但什么都没有产生效果。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: We were doing.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在做。

sentences.en: What steps did you take that were not effective?
sentences.zh: 你采取了哪些无效的措施？

sentences.en: The testing was supposed to be step one.
sentences.zh: 检测本应是第一步。

sentences.en: That was supposed to slow the spread.
sentences.zh: 那本应减缓传播速度。

sentences.en: That didn't work.
sentences.zh: 但没起作用。

sentences.en: Okay, the enemy keeps coming.
sentences.zh: 好吧，敌人还在不断逼近。

sentences.en: You start moderate social distancing.
sentences.zh: 你开始进行适度的社交距离限制。

sentences.en: Businesses, voluntary basis, work from home.
sentences.zh: 企业，自愿性质，居家办公。

sentences.en: That didn't make any difference.
sentences.zh: 那没有任何区别。

sentences.en: The numbers have kept going up regardless of everything we did.
sentences.zh: 无论我们做了什么，数字一直在上升。

sentences.en: When you keep seeing those numbers increase, your efforts have to become more and more dramatic.
sentences.zh: 当你不断看到这些数字增加时，你的努力就必须变得越来越剧烈。

sentences.en: Yesterday, we went to the point of closing bars, restaurants, gyms, and schools.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我们到了关闭酒吧、餐馆、健身房和学校的地步。

sentences.en: With the precaution of providing childcare for essential workers, especially nurses, healthcare workers, the next level of efforts to control density, control the spread,
sentences.zh: 在为必要工作人员，特别是护士、医护人员提供托儿服务的预防措施下，下一步控制密度、控制传播的努力，

sentences.en: would be to start closing, mandatory closing of businesses.
sentences.zh: 将是开始关闭，强制关闭企业。

sentences.en: Let me focus in on that decision, bars, restaurants, because that is billions of dollars in lost revenue.
sentences.zh: 让我聚焦于那个决定，酒吧和餐馆，因为那意味着数十亿美元的收入损失。

sentences.en: It's tens of thousands of people out of work.
sentences.zh: 这意味着成千上万的人失业。

sentences.en: On my way here, I got a text from a friend who said he had just laid off 90 employees, and he was crying the whole time he had to do it.
sentences.zh: 在来这里的路上，我收到一位朋友的短信，他说他刚刚解雇了90名员工，他在做这件事的时候一直在哭。

sentences.en: So let's talk about how you made that decision because of the impact that that is immediately going to have.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来谈谈你是如何做出那个决定的，因为这会产生直接的影响。

sentences.en: It's a huge part of the economy in the state.
sentences.zh: 这是该州经济的很大一部分。

sentences.en: And so how did you get to that decision?
sentences.zh: 那么你是如何做出那个决定的呢？

sentences.en: Michael, you are past the point of monetizing these decisions.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你已经过了用金钱衡量这些决定的阶段了。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: You are at a point of deciding how many people are going to live, how many people are going to die.
sentences.zh: 你现在处于决定有多少人能活下来，有多少人会死去的阶段。

sentences.en: Everybody, that's where you are.
sentences.zh: 每个人，这就是你所处的境地。

sentences.en: Closing restaurants reduces the spread of the disease.
sentences.zh: 关闭餐馆可以减少疾病的传播。

sentences.en: The disease transfers very quickly, not just in the cough, in the droplets, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病传播得非常快，不仅仅是通过咳嗽、飞沫等等。

sentences.en: There are some studies that say the disease can live, the virus can live up to two or three days on a surface.
sentences.zh: 有一些研究表明，这种疾病可以存活，病毒可以在物体表面存活两到三天。

sentences.en: Like a table at a restaurant?
sentences.zh: 比如餐馆的桌子？

sentences.en: Just think about that.
sentences.zh: 好好想想吧。

sentences.en: Like a table in a restaurant, like a sink, like a handrail in a bus, two or three days.
sentences.zh: 比如餐馆的桌子、水槽、公交车上的扶手，两到三天。

sentences.en: I mean, it's why this virus is so vicious.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是为什么这种病毒如此凶猛。

sentences.en: And we know the trajectory right now overwhelms the hospital system.
sentences.zh: 我们知道目前的传播轨迹会压垮医院系统。

sentences.en: Three or fourfold.
sentences.zh: 三到四倍之多。

sentences.en: It's not even close.
sentences.zh: 根本没法比。

sentences.en: People will die because they can't get the health care service they need.
sentences.zh: 人们会因为无法获得所需的医疗服务而死亡。

sentences.en: So you're reducing the number of people who die because they can't get into a hospital bed for every restaurant you close and every transmission you prevent in closing that restaurant.
sentences.zh: 所以，你每关闭一家餐馆，每阻止一次传播，就是在减少因为住不进医院而死亡的人数。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键就在这里。

sentences.en: It's just pure numbers.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是数字问题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's not even just New York.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是纽约的问题。

sentences.en: The whole nation is past the point of let's try to save money, right?
sentences.zh: 整个国家都已经过了那种试图省钱的阶段了，对吧？

sentences.en: You look at the Dow Jones market.
sentences.zh: 看看道琼斯指数就知道了。

sentences.en: You look at all the businesses that are closing.
sentences.zh: 看看所有正在倒闭的企业。

sentences.en: This is now a national phenomenon that this economy is going to be very badly hurt.
sentences.zh: 这现在是一个全国性的现象，经济将受到重创。

sentences.en: The recovery of this economy is going to be an economic feat never seen before.
sentences.zh: 这次经济复苏将是一项前所未有的经济壮举。

sentences.en: You're going to have to go back to the Great Depression to come up with a revival plan for the economy like we're seeing now.
sentences.zh: 你得回到大萧条时期，才能想出像我们现在看到的这种经济复兴计划。

sentences.en: You're going to see mortgage foreclosures.
sentences.zh: 你会看到抵押贷款止赎。

sentences.en: You're going to see bankruptcies.
sentences.zh: 你会看到企业破产。

sentences.en: You're going to see massive unemployment claims all across the board.
sentences.zh: 你会看到全面爆发的大规模失业申请。

sentences.en: I don't see you sugarcoating this at all.
sentences.zh: 我看得出你一点都没有粉饰太平。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: This is going to be our state finances are decimated, right?
sentences.zh: 我们的州财政将会被摧毁，对吧？

sentences.en: How does the state work?
sentences.zh: 州政府是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: The state is just a percentage of every other business.
sentences.zh: 州政府的收入只是其他所有企业收入的一个百分比。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Those businesses are all closed or their revenues have been cut by 50, 60, 70 percent.
sentences.zh: 那些企业要么全部倒闭，要么收入减少了50%、60%甚至70%。

sentences.en: But I think the good thing as a nation is we said, so what?
sentences.zh: 但我认为作为一个国家，好的一面是我们说，那又怎样？

sentences.en: So what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: What value on a human life?
sentences.zh: 人的生命价值几何？

sentences.en: If I can save here 5,000 lives, 10,000 lives, I don't care what it costs, Michael.
sentences.zh: 如果我能在这里挽救5000条、10000条生命，我不在乎代价是什么，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Well, that's what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是我要做的。

sentences.en: I wonder what you want to say to somebody who has just lost their job because there are now a lot of them who may not be able to pay their rent,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，对于那些刚刚失业的人，你有什么想说的？因为现在有很多人可能付不起房租，

sentences.en: who may not be able to pay their mortgage, who may lose their housing, and who are really scared because of these economic consequences.
sentences.zh: 可能付不起抵押贷款，可能失去住房，而且因为这些经济后果而感到非常害怕。

sentences.en: What do you want them to hear you saying?
sentences.zh: 你希望他们听到你说什么？

sentences.en: I would say first, I hope no one in your family or no one you know dies because of this, because that's what we're trying to accomplish.
sentences.zh: 首先我想说，我希望你的家人或你认识的人中没有人因为这个而去世，因为这就是我们努力想要实现的目标。

sentences.en: I hope no one in your family dies.
sentences.zh: 我希望你的家人中没有人去世。

sentences.en: Second, we all understand the economic consequences.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们都理解经济后果。

sentences.en: It's not just you.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是你。

sentences.en: It is everyone.
sentences.zh: 是所有人。

sentences.en: And by the way, take solace in that fact because maybe if it was just you, you could be forgotten and left on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，从这个事实中寻求安慰吧，因为如果只是你一个人，你可能会被遗忘，被抛弃在路边。

sentences.en: It's not just you.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是你。

sentences.en: It's everyone and it's everywhere.
sentences.zh: 是所有人，到处都是这样。

sentences.en: The Italians have an old saying that the rich man is the man who has health, right?
sentences.zh: 意大利有句古话，说富有的人就是拥有健康的人，对吧？

sentences.en: If you have your health, you can figure anything else out.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有健康，其他任何事情都能解决。

sentences.en: And it's true.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: We'll figure out the economy.
sentences.zh: 我们会解决经济问题的。

sentences.en: You know, I went through 9-11.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我经历过9·11事件。

sentences.en: Oh, downtown Manhattan is devastated.
sentences.zh: 哦，曼哈顿市中心被摧毁了。

sentences.en: We have to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 我们必须重建。

sentences.en: How do we do this?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么做？

sentences.en: We're alive, first of all.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们还活着。

sentences.en: And if we are alive, we'll figure out the reSt.
sentences.zh: 只要我们还活着，剩下的问题我们都能解决。

sentences.en: We'll figure out the money.
sentences.zh: 我们会解决钱的问题。

sentences.en: It's making sure we live through this.
sentences.zh: 关键是确保我们能挺过这一关。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Governor, I want to understand how you're thinking about something else, which is hospitals, supplies, and readiness.
sentences.zh: 州长，我想了解一下你对另一件事的看法，那就是医院、物资和准备工作。

sentences.en: You've started to signal that there's a major shortage of ICU units.
sentences.zh: 你已经开始发出信号，表示重症监护室（ICU）严重短缺。

sentences.en: What about respirators?
sentences.zh: 呼吸机呢？

sentences.en: I mean, what does the picture start to look like in a couple of weeks?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，几周后的情况会是什么样？

sentences.en: And are we ready for it?
sentences.zh: 我们准备好了吗？

sentences.en: We are not ready for it, certainly, today.
sentences.zh: 我们当然还没有准备好，至少今天还没有。

sentences.en: The picture looks like you have tens of thousands of people coming to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 情况看起来会有成千上万的人涌向医院。

sentences.en: These are respiratory illnesses.
sentences.zh: 这些都是呼吸道疾病。

sentences.en: They can't breathe.
sentences.zh: 他们无法呼吸。

sentences.en: They need an ICU bed with a ventilator.
sentences.zh: 他们需要配备呼吸机的ICU床位。

sentences.en: Okay, buy more ventilators.
sentences.zh: 好吧，多买些呼吸机。

sentences.en: Okay, you can't.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你买不到。

sentences.en: You can't.
sentences.zh: 你买不到。

sentences.en: Because the entire world is trying to buy ventilators.
sentences.zh: 因为全世界都在抢购呼吸机。

sentences.en: So you've tried to buy ventilators.
sentences.zh: 所以你尝试过购买呼吸机吗？

sentences.en: We try every which way to buy ventilators.
sentences.zh: 我们尝试了各种方法去购买呼吸机。

sentences.en: We're trying to go to China, which is now over it, trying to buy their ventilators.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图联系中国，他们现在已经挺过来了，试图购买他们的呼吸机。

sentences.en: I mean, it is a global competition to buy ventilators.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一场全球性的呼吸机抢购竞赛。

sentences.en: The federal government has an emergency medical stockpile.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府有紧急医疗储备物资。

sentences.en: I reached out to the president.
sentences.zh: 我联系了总统。

sentences.en: Federal cooperation is everything, Michael, because it's whatever the federal government has in that stockpile is going to be our main access.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府的合作至关重要，迈克尔，因为联邦政府储备库里有什么，将是我们主要的获取渠道。

sentences.en: Did you ask to tap into the stockpile?
sentences.zh: 你要求动用储备物资了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And what did the president say?
sentences.zh: 总统怎么说？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 他说可以。

sentences.en: If I can ask.
sentences.zh: 如果我可以问的话。

sentences.en: He has said he will be very helpful.
sentences.zh: 他说他会非常乐意提供帮助。

sentences.en: We're looking at the Army Corps of Engineers to try to build additional hospital beds,
sentences.zh: 我们正在考虑让陆军工程兵团来建造额外的医院床位，

sentences.en: convert dormitories, et cetera, because you're overwhelming the capacity of the health care system by two or three times.
sentences.zh: 改造宿舍等等，因为医疗系统的承载能力即将被压垮两到三倍。

sentences.en: You need backup staff, backup nurses, backup doctors, more space, more equipment, more gloves, more food, more everything.
sentences.zh: 你需要后备人员、后备护士、后备医生、更多的空间、更多的设备、更多的手套、更多的食物，更多的一切。

sentences.en: Is there a version where hospitals can handle this influx, or is it just a matter of how short they fall?
sentences.zh: 有没有一种可能让医院应对这种涌入，还是说这只是一个缺口有多大的问题？

sentences.en: There is no way they can handle this.
sentences.zh: 他们根本无法应对这种情况。

sentences.en: So then, do you accept that some incredibly difficult decisions are going to have to be made inside hospitals in the coming days?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是否接受在接下来的几天里，医院内部将不得不做出一些极其艰难的决定？

sentences.en: Decisions of who lives and who dies, who gets a bed, who doesn't, who gets a respirator, who doesn't get a respirator,
sentences.zh: 关于谁生谁死、谁能得到床位、谁不能、谁能用上呼吸机、谁用不上呼吸机的决定，

sentences.en: or who to prioritize, is that something doctors should be deciding, or is that something government should be playing a role in?
sentences.zh: 或者优先救治谁，这是医生应该决定的，还是政府应该在其中发挥作用？

sentences.en: It will be a question of triage.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个分诊的问题。

sentences.en: Remember, most of these people will have serious underlying conditions already.
sentences.zh: 记住，这些人中的大多数人本身就已经有严重的潜在疾病了。

sentences.en: And in some ways, it will become self-selecting, depending on how ill you were when you came in.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这将成为一种自我选择，取决于你入院时病情的严重程度。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But when the decision has to be made, do I put the 85-year-old with underlying conditions in the ICU who might have a 50-50 chance,
sentences.zh: 但当必须做出决定时，我是把那个有潜在疾病、可能有一半生存机会的85岁老人送进ICU，

sentences.en: or do I put a 45-year-old in the ICU who's come in with respiratory problems who has a 60% chance?
sentences.zh: 还是把一个有60%生存机会、因呼吸问题入院的45岁的人送进ICU？

sentences.en: We just talked to a doctor in Italy who had to make these choices.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚和一位在意大利不得不做出这些选择的医生谈过。

sentences.en: Do you want to be the one issuing protocols?
sentences.zh: 你想成为发布这些规程的人吗？

sentences.en: Do you want the president to be issuing those protocols?
sentences.zh: 你希望总统发布这些规程吗？

sentences.en: Who should be guiding those kind of awful decisions?
sentences.zh: 谁应该来指导这些可怕的决定？

sentences.en: Well, I pray we don't get there, but if we get there, it should be a medical decision unless God intervenes and God makes the determination firSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我祈祷我们不会走到那一步，但如果真的到了那一步，这应该是一个医疗决定，除非上帝介入，由上帝先做出裁决。

sentences.en: What is the ideal role of the federal government right now, in your mind?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，联邦政府目前理想的角色是什么？

sentences.en: Right now, crank up the Army Corps of Engineers, which does have building capacity, add to hospital capacity in the states that need it.
sentences.zh: 现在，启动陆军工程兵团，他们确实有建设能力，在需要的州增加医院容量。

sentences.en: New York would be at the top of the liSt.
sentences.zh: 纽约州应该排在名单的首位。

sentences.en: That's what they do, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的职责，对吧？

sentences.en: They build the infrastructure for war.
sentences.zh: 他们为战争建设基础设施。

sentences.en: They go into a country where nothing exists.
sentences.zh: 他们进入一个一无所有的国家。

sentences.en: They cut down trees.
sentences.zh: 他们砍伐树木。

sentences.en: They build roads.
sentences.zh: 他们修建道路。

sentences.en: They build camps.
sentences.zh: 他们建立营地。

sentences.en: Because the states don't have the capacity or the resources.
sentences.zh: 因为各州没有这种能力或资源。

sentences.en: I don't have a workforce.
sentences.zh: 我没有这样的劳动力。

sentences.en: Mobilize FEMA, Federal Emergency Management Agency, which has tremendous potential when it works well, right?
sentences.zh: 动员联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA），当它运作良好时，它有巨大的潜力，对吧？

sentences.en: FEMA did Hurricane Katrina, which was FEMA not doing a good job.
sentences.zh: FEMA处理过卡特里娜飓风，那次FEMA表现得并不好。

sentences.en: FEMA can be extraordinarily good when it's staffed and funded.
sentences.zh: 当人员配备齐全、资金充足时，FEMA可以表现得非常出色。

sentences.en: So we need them fully deployed here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要他们在这里全面部署。

sentences.en: And are they doing that?
sentences.zh: 他们正在这样做吗？

sentences.en: The president has now, I believe yesterday, the president's tone was 100% serious.
sentences.zh: 总统现在，我相信是昨天，总统的语气是100%严肃的。

sentences.en: He showed more sobriety on this issue than he has shown.
sentences.zh: 他在这个问题上表现出了比以往任何时候都更清醒的态度。

sentences.en: I spoke with him twice today already.
sentences.zh: 我今天已经和他谈过两次了。

sentences.en: I know he has his team working.
sentences.zh: 我知道他的团队正在工作。

sentences.en: I was on the phone with him late last night, early this morning.
sentences.zh: 我昨天深夜和今天清晨都和他通过电话。

sentences.en: So I believe he is fully committed and he understands the role and he understands the severity.
sentences.zh: 所以我相信他完全投入了，他理解自己的角色，也理解事情的严重性。

sentences.en: And that is good news.
sentences.zh: 这是个好消息。

sentences.en: Let me ask you directly, what do you think of President Trump's leadership in this moment?
sentences.zh: 让我直接问你，你如何看待特朗普总统在这一时刻的领导力？

sentences.en: It began with some skepticism about the severity of the situation.
sentences.zh: 起初他对局势的严重性持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: It has changed like you just signaled.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，情况已经改变了。

sentences.en: Is the president your partner here?
sentences.zh: 总统现在是你的合作伙伴吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, let me say this.
sentences.zh: 是的，让我这么说吧。

sentences.en: I have had a tumultuous relationship with this president.
sentences.zh: 我和这位总统的关系一直很动荡。

sentences.en: I have opposed many of his policies vociferously.
sentences.zh: 我曾激烈地反对他的许多政策。

sentences.en: You could probably say there has been no governor in the country who has been as aggressive in his opposition to the president as I have.
sentences.zh: 你大概可以说，全国没有哪位州长像我这样积极地反对总统。

sentences.en: Both ideologically and practically.
sentences.zh: 无论是在意识形态上还是在实际行动上。

sentences.en: And I probably have sued the president more than any governor in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我起诉总统的次数可能比美国任何一位州长都多。

sentences.en: So having said that, I said to the president again this morning, look, forget everything.
sentences.zh: 所以话虽如此，我今天早上又对总统说，听着，忘记一切吧。

sentences.en: Forget Democrats.
sentences.zh: 忘记民主党人。

sentences.en: Forget Republicans.
sentences.zh: 忘记共和党人。

sentences.en: We're Americans.
sentences.zh: 我们是美国人。

sentences.en: And that always came firSt.
sentences.zh: 这一点始终是第一位的。

sentences.en: And that's where we are.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在的处境。

sentences.en: I put out my hand in partnership.
sentences.zh: 我伸出了合作之手。

sentences.en: I need your help.
sentences.zh: 我需要你的帮助。

sentences.en: I'm grateful for your help.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你的帮助。

sentences.en: I'll be a committed partner.
sentences.zh: 我会成为一个尽职的合作伙伴。

sentences.en: Let's get this done.
sentences.zh: 让我们把这件事办成吧。

sentences.en: Let's save lives.
sentences.zh: 让我们去拯救生命。

sentences.en: Did he say anything to make you feel like that was to be reciprocated?
sentences.zh: 他有没有说什么让你觉得那是理应回报的？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He said, yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, this country has gotten itself into this hyper-partisan hype.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个国家已经陷入了这种极度党派化的炒作之中。

sentences.en: You know, this ideological intensity.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种意识形态的狂热。

sentences.en: And I understand why.
sentences.zh: 我理解为什么会这样。

sentences.en: It has been for me, too, in truth.
sentences.zh: 说实话，对我来说也是如此。

sentences.en: But then something happens, and it changes your whole perspective, right?
sentences.zh: 但后来发生了一些事，改变了你整个的视角，对吧？

sentences.en: You can be fighting in your family with your siblings, and I'm not going to go to your birthday party, and I'm not going to.
sentences.zh: 你可能在家里和兄弟姐妹吵架，说我才不去参加你的生日派对，我才不呢。

sentences.en: And then the parent dies, and you say to each other, like, what have we been doing?
sentences.zh: 然后父母去世了，你们会互相问，我们到底在干什么？

sentences.en: What a waste of time.
sentences.zh: 真是浪费时间。

sentences.en: You think we're at a moment that may transcend?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们正处于一个可能超越这种状态的时刻吗？

sentences.en: You're talking about Americans dying here.
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是美国人正在死去。

sentences.en: That's what you're talking about, Americans dying.
sentences.zh: 这才是你谈论的重点，美国人正在死去。

sentences.en: Forget everything else.
sentences.zh: 忘了其他一切吧。

sentences.en: Life is, is life and death.
sentences.zh: 生命，就是生死攸关的事。

sentences.en: And that changes your perspective.
sentences.zh: 这会改变你的视角。

sentences.en: You know, we can have the arguments another day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可以改天再争论。

sentences.en: It also changes, by the way, your perspective on government.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这也改变了你对政府的看法。

sentences.en: Think about this.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: When was the last time this country actually needed government?
sentences.zh: 这个国家上一次真正需要政府是什么时候？

sentences.en: Needed it.
sentences.zh: 真正需要它。

sentences.en: Needed it to be competent and qualified.
sentences.zh: 需要它胜任且称职。

sentences.en: And needed leaders to be real leaders.
sentences.zh: 需要领导者成为真正的领导者。

sentences.en: Not celebrity leaders.
sentences.zh: 而不是明星式的领导者。

sentences.en: Not good-looking, handsome, charismatic leaders.
sentences.zh: 不是那种长得好看、英俊、有魅力的领导者。

sentences.en: I like this one.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: This one's sexy.
sentences.zh: 这个很性感。

sentences.en: This one's funny.
sentences.zh: 这个很有趣。

sentences.en: It's a totally different lens.
sentences.zh: 这是完全不同的视角。

sentences.en: No, this thing called government is very serious.
sentences.zh: 不，这个叫政府的东西非常严肃。

sentences.en: It's a serious business.
sentences.zh: 这是一项严肃的事业。

sentences.en: You have to know what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 你必须知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: You have to know how to mobilize.
sentences.zh: 你必须知道如何动员。

sentences.en: What is this Army Corps of Engineers and FEMA?
sentences.zh: 什么是陆军工程兵团和联邦紧急事务管理局？

sentences.en: And how do you build a hospital in 45 days?
sentences.zh: 你如何在45天内建起一座医院？

sentences.en: And how do you do triage?
sentences.zh: 你如何进行分诊？

sentences.en: And how do you make all these things happen?
sentences.zh: 你如何让所有这些事情发生？

sentences.en: And state-local relations.
sentences.zh: 还有州与地方的关系。

sentences.en: And passing emergency appropriations.
sentences.zh: 以及通过紧急拨款。

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.en: What kind of measures should your constituents, should all New Yorkers, and maybe even people beyond New York, be getting ready to take on?
sentences.zh: 你的选民，所有纽约人，甚至纽约以外的人，应该准备好采取什么样的措施？

sentences.en: As we walked into this room, we got word, for example, that it looks like New York is going
sentences.zh: 当我们走进这个房间时，我们得到消息，例如，看起来纽约打算

sentences.en: to essentially order a shelter-in-place condition, which means basically you can't leave your house.
sentences.zh: 基本上要下达就地避难令，这意味着你基本上不能离开家。

sentences.en: What more is coming?
sentences.zh: 还有什么要出台的？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That is not going to happen, shelter-in-place.
sentences.zh: 那不会发生，就地避难。

sentences.en: For New York City or any city or county to take an emergency action, the state has to approve it.
sentences.zh: 纽约市或任何城市或县要采取紧急行动，必须得到州政府的批准。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't approve shelter-in-place.
sentences.zh: 而我不会批准就地避难。

sentences.en: That scares people, right?
sentences.zh: 那会吓到人们，对吧？

sentences.en: Quarantine-in-place, you can't leave your home.
sentences.zh: 就地隔离，你不能离开家。

sentences.en: The fear, the panic, is a bigger problem than the virus.
sentences.zh: 恐惧和恐慌比病毒本身更严重。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I shut that down immediately.
sentences.zh: 我立即叫停了那个想法。

sentences.en: The density control measures would be more, we're going to close businesses.
sentences.zh: 密度控制措施会更多，我们要关闭企业。

sentences.en: You're going to potentially close all businesses.
sentences.zh: 你可能会关闭所有企业。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: Italy took the most drastic density control that only essential businesses, grocery stores, first responders, pharmacies, etc.
sentences.zh: 意大利采取了最严厉的密度控制，只有基本业务，如杂货店、急救人员、药店等可以营业。

sentences.en: But I am against quarantines.
sentences.zh: 但我反对隔离。

sentences.en: You must stay in your home.
sentences.zh: 你必须待在家里。

sentences.en: You can come out of your house.
sentences.zh: 你可以走出家门。

sentences.en: Just don't be in a crowded situation.
sentences.zh: 只是不要去拥挤的地方。

sentences.en: Don't cause more density.
sentences.zh: 不要造成更多的人员聚集。

sentences.en: Don't sneeze in someone's face within six feet.
sentences.zh: 不要在六英尺内对着别人的脸打喷嚏。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Go walk in the park.
sentences.zh: 去公园散散步。

sentences.en: I mean, that is a nice thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那是一件好事。

sentences.en: That's a positive suggestion.
sentences.zh: 那是个积极的建议。

sentences.en: You go walk in the park.
sentences.zh: 你去公园散步。

sentences.en: No, I try to take an evening walk.
sentences.zh: 不，我尽量去散个晚步。

sentences.en: I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: The old neighborhood, they used to say, go take a walk in the park.
sentences.zh: 老街坊们过去常说，去公园散散步吧。

sentences.en: That was a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 那可不是什么好事。

sentences.en: In Queens.
sentences.zh: 在皇后区。

sentences.en: In Queens.
sentences.zh: 在皇后区。

sentences.en: If we're at a moment where it's too late to look back and say, if only we had done this, if only we'd done that.
sentences.zh: 如果我们正处于一个为时已晚，无法回头说“要是我们当时做了这个，要是我们当时做了那个”的时刻。

sentences.en: And instead, we're at a moment where even if the government steps up in every way we want it to, everyone now has to do their part as well.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们正处于一个即使政府以我们希望的各种方式挺身而出，每个人现在也必须尽自己一份力的时刻。

sentences.en: What's your message to them?
sentences.zh: 你对他们有什么话要说？

sentences.en: First of all, welcome to life.
sentences.zh: 首先，欢迎来到现实生活。

sentences.en: If I had only done this, if I had only done this, if I had only done this, that's life, my brother.
sentences.zh: 如果我当时做了这个，如果我当时做了那个，如果我当时做了那个，这就是生活，兄弟。

sentences.en: That's all of us.
sentences.zh: 我们都是如此。

sentences.en: I forget that.
sentences.zh: 我忘了这一点。

sentences.en: You're here now.
sentences.zh: 你现在就在这里。

sentences.en: What do you do now?
sentences.zh: 你现在该做什么？

sentences.en: And that's all that matters.
sentences.zh: 这才是最重要的。

sentences.en: The enemy has not advanced to a point where they are in the foxhole, right?
sentences.zh: 敌人还没有推进到他们进入战壕的地步，对吧？

sentences.en: We still have some time.
sentences.zh: 我们还有些时间。

sentences.en: Not much.
sentences.zh: 不多了。

sentences.en: Not much.
sentences.zh: 不多了。

sentences.en: But what we do between now and then matters gravely.
sentences.zh: 但我们从现在到那时所做的一切都至关重要。

sentences.en: Do everything you can.
sentences.zh: 尽你所能去做。

sentences.en: Do everything you can to flatten that curve.
sentences.zh: 尽你所能去拉平那条曲线。

sentences.en: Yes, your friend who owns the restaurant, I'm sure, is very angry at me.
sentences.zh: 是的，你那位开餐馆的朋友，我肯定他对我非常生气。

sentences.en: But you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: I did it because I believe it was necessary to save lives.
sentences.zh: 我这样做是因为我相信这是拯救生命所必需的。

sentences.en: We're going to have to take more actions like that to reduce the density and flatten the curve.
sentences.zh: 我们将不得不采取更多这样的行动来降低密度并拉平曲线。

sentences.en: Do everything you can to build more hospital beds in 45 days.
sentences.zh: 尽你所能去在45天内建造更多的医院床位。

sentences.en: Well, it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是不可能的。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I'm going to try my damnedest to show you it's not impossible.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但我会尽我最大的努力向你证明那并非不可能。

sentences.en: Do everything that you can humanly possibly do.
sentences.zh: 尽你人力所能及的一切去努力。

sentences.en: Extend your imagination in a way you never thought.
sentences.zh: 以你从未想过的方式扩展你的想象力。

sentences.en: Extend your ambition beyond yourself because it's not about you.
sentences.zh: 将你的抱负扩展到自身之外，因为这不仅仅关乎你。

sentences.en: It's about us.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我们。

sentences.en: It's about the collective.
sentences.zh: 这关乎集体。

sentences.en: It's about society.
sentences.zh: 这关乎社会。

sentences.en: Don't expose yourself to other people.
sentences.zh: 不要让自己暴露在其他人面前。

sentences.en: Don't indulge yourself.
sentences.zh: 不要放纵自己。

sentences.en: Yeah, I know you really want to go out and go shopping.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我知道你真的很想出去逛街。

sentences.en: And then, yeah, I know you do.
sentences.zh: 然后，是啊，我知道你想。

sentences.en: But don't think of just yourself.
sentences.zh: 但不要只想着你自己。

sentences.en: Save as many lives as you can.
sentences.zh: 尽可能多地拯救生命。

sentences.en: Be responsible.
sentences.zh: 要有责任感。

sentences.en: Be civic-minded.
sentences.zh: 要有公民意识。

sentences.en: Be kind.
sentences.zh: 要善良。

sentences.en: Be considerate.
sentences.zh: 要体贴。

sentences.en: Think of one another.
sentences.zh: 多为彼此着想。

sentences.en: Yes, we're going to have an inconvenient period for a few months.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们将经历几个月的不便时期。

sentences.en: We are.
sentences.zh: 确实会。

sentences.en: Deal with it.
sentences.zh: 去面对它。

sentences.en: And deal with it gracefully.
sentences.zh: 并优雅地面对它。

sentences.en: And deal with it with kindness and intelligence.
sentences.zh: 并以善良和智慧去面对它。

sentences.en: Oh, Governor, I really appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 哦，州长，我真的很感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you for having us in.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你接待我们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And good luck getting through all this.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运，度过这一切难关。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That's how we keep our space.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们保持距离的方式。

sentences.en: Can I just ask a quick question?
sentences.zh: 我可以问一个简短的问题吗？

sentences.en: If it says New York City tells 8 million people to be prepared to shelter in place, that is not going to happen?
sentences.zh: 如果说纽约市告诉800万人准备好就地避难，那不会发生？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: But it's playing on the television right now.
sentences.zh: 但电视上现在正在播放这个消息。

sentences.en: Yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我知道。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: So what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 那你打算怎么做？

sentences.en: See, I don't know anyone at CNN.
sentences.zh: 你看，我又不认识CNN的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, but see how scary that is?
sentences.zh: 是啊，但你明白那有多吓人吗？

sentences.en: Your brother is an anchor on CNN.
sentences.zh: 你哥可是CNN的主播。

sentences.en: That was a joke.
sentences.zh: 那是开玩笑的。

sentences.en: Ba-da-boom.
sentences.zh: 吧嗒蹦。

sentences.en: Ba-da-boom.
sentences.zh: 吧嗒蹦。

sentences.en: Ba-da-boom.
sentences.zh: 吧嗒蹦。

sentences.en: I normally hold up a little sign and say, joke coming.
sentences.zh: 我通常会举个小牌子，写着“笑话来了”。

sentences.en: No, but I'm sorry to interrupt, but in all seriousness, if that's on CNN right now.
sentences.zh: 不，抱歉打断一下，但说真的，如果那事现在就在CNN上播。

sentences.en: We already put a statement out that said that we were not considering it.
sentences.zh: 我们已经发表声明说我们没在考虑这件事了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So it'll be clarified, hopefully, in the next five minutes.
sentences.zh: 所以希望在接下来的五分钟内能澄清这一点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But that's why the fear, why the panic.
sentences.zh: 但这就是恐惧和恐慌的来源。

sentences.en: Because you watch things like that all day.
sentences.zh: 因为你们整天都在看那种新闻。

sentences.en: And everybody, somebody says something, and then it's on the screen right away.
sentences.zh: 每个人，随便谁说点什么，马上就出现在屏幕上了。

sentences.en: Oh, my God, I'm going to be locked in my home.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我要被关在家里了。

sentences.en: I better go to the store and buy stuff.
sentences.zh: 我最好去商店买点东西。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, dozens of countries moved to close their borders to slow the spread of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 周二，数十个国家采取行动关闭边境，以减缓新冠病毒的传播。

sentences.en: The less travel, the more we can contain the virus.
sentences.zh: 旅行越少，我们就能越好地控制病毒。

sentences.en: Therefore, I propose to the heads of state and government to introduce temporary restriction on non-essential travel to the European Union.
sentences.zh: 因此，我建议各国国家元首和政府首脑对前往欧盟的非必要旅行实施临时限制。

sentences.en: The European Union voted to shut off at least 26 of its nations to nearly all outside visitors for at least 30 days and perhaps longer,
sentences.zh: 欧盟投票决定至少在30天内，甚至可能更久，对几乎所有外来访客关闭至少26个成员国的大门，

sentences.en: while Russia will bar entry to most foreigners starting today.
sentences.zh: 而俄罗斯从今天起将禁止大多数外国人入境。

sentences.en: In the United States, where thousands of businesses have stopped operating over the past few days, the Trump administration said it was racing to stimulate the economy,
sentences.zh: 在美国，过去几天里已有数千家企业停止运营，特朗普政府表示正在加紧刺激经济，

sentences.en: to stave off a deep recession.
sentences.zh: 以避免严重的经济衰退。

sentences.en: We're looking at sending checks to Americans immediately.
sentences.zh: 我们正在考虑立即向美国民众发放支票。

sentences.en: And what we've heard from hardworking Americans, many companies have now shut down, whether it's bars or restaurants.
sentences.zh: 我们从辛勤工作的美国人那里了解到，许多公司现在已经关门了，无论是酒吧还是餐馆。

sentences.en: Americans need cash now, and the president wants to get cash now.
sentences.zh: 美国人现在需要现金，总统也希望现在就给他们现金。

sentences.en: During a news conference, Treasury Secretary Steve Mnuchin outlined a plan under negotiation with Congress for direct payments to Americans.
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，财政部长史蒂夫·姆努钦概述了一项正在与国会协商的计划，旨在向美国民众直接发放款项。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, on Tuesday night, West Virginia became the 50th state to report an infection.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，周二晚间，西弗吉尼亚州成为第50个报告感染病例的州。

sentences.en: And Joe Biden won all three primaries on Tuesday in Florida, Illinois, and Arizona, dashing Bernie Sanders' hope of a comeback and solidifying Biden's lead.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在周二佛罗里达州、伊利诺伊州和亚利桑那州的全部三场初选中获胜，粉碎了伯尼·桑德斯卷土重来的希望，并巩固了拜登的领先地位。

sentences.en: You know, it's the moments like these that we realize we need to put politics aside and work together as Americans.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正是这样的时刻让我们意识到，我们需要抛开政治，作为美国人团结协作。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, Biden devoted much of his victory speech to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 周二晚间，拜登将胜选演讲的大部分篇幅都留给了疫情。

sentences.en: The coronavirus doesn't care if you're a Democrat or Republican.
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒不在乎你是民主党人还是共和党人。

sentences.en: It will not discriminate based on national origin, race, gender, or your zip code.
sentences.zh: 它不会根据国籍、种族、性别或邮政编码来区别对待。

sentences.en: It will touch people in positions of power, as well as the most vulnerable people in our society.
sentences.zh: 它会触及身居高位的人，也会触及我们社会中最脆弱的群体。

sentences.en: We're all in this together.
sentences.zh: 我们同舟共济。

sentences.en: This is a moment for each of us.
sentences.zh: 这是属于我们每个人的时刻。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
